Trump Expresses Desire for 2028 US Presidential Run

Former US President Donald Trump stated he would "love to run" for a third term in 2028. He acknowledged the 22nd Amendment, which limits presidents to two terms. Trump made these remarks in a recent statement, indicating his interest in a future presidential bid.
